candidate_relations.reason: Although S100 positivity can occur in schwannoma, the described hypocellular, hypovascular lesion with abundant myxoid stroma supports myxoma rather than schwannoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor of the ciliary body.

candidate_relations.reason: “Myxoma of the ciliary body” is a wording variant of the reference diagnosis, ciliary body myxoma.
Patchy GFAP positivity alone does not establish glial choristoma; the morphology and ciliary body location support myxoma.
The lesion lacks epithelial components, mitoses, and atypia and instead shows characteristic hypocellular myxoid histology.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different ciliary body neoplasm with epithelial and neuroepithelial differentiation.
